description: Copy a clip's effects to other clips of the same kind (Edit > Copy, then Paste Attributes): applied effects are added to each target with the source's values and keyframes; with intrinsic: true, Motion, Opacity, Time Remapping (video) or Volume, Channel Volume, Panner (audio) values are copied onto the targets' own. Keyframes keep their offset from the clip's In point. Up to three undo steps: adding effects, values, keyframe interpolation

components.description: Only these component indexes of the source (from list_clip_effects). Default: every applied effect, plus the fixed ones with intrinsic

from.description: The clip to copy from, as list_clips reports it

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

intrinsic.description: Also copy the fixed effects' values when components is not given. Default false

keyframes.description: Copy keyframes of animated parameters (otherwise their value at the clip start). Default true

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

items.description: A clip in the sequence, as list_clips reports it

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

selected.description: Include the clips selected in the Timeline

name: copy_clip_effects
title: Copy Clip Effects
